specs.Compatible Devices: Cellphones, Desktops, Gaming Consoles, Laptops, Tablets

features: HALF IN-EAR DESIGN FOR EVERYDAY COMFORT: Noise Buds Mini X feature a compact half in-ear design for a comfortable everyday listening experience, especially for users who find conventional in-ear earbuds uncomfortable or bulky, suitable for daily commutes, work calls and entertainment

12MM TITANIUM-COATED DRIVERS FOR POWERFUL SOUND: Experience rich, immersive audio with 12mm drivers featuring titanium coating, designed to deliver powerful bass, clear vocals and an engaging listening experience across your favorite music, videos and content

QUAD MIC ENC FOR CLEARER CALLS: Stay connected with Quad Mic Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC), designed to reduce surrounding noise during calls for clearer voice pickup while commuting, working or catching up with friends and family

UP TO 50 HOURS PLAYTIME WITH INSTACHARGE: Keep your music going with up to 50 hours of total playtime with the charging case, and just 10 minutes of charging delivers up to 2 hours of playback with Instacharge technology

40MS LOW LATENCY, DUAL PAIRING & BLUETOOTH 6.0: Enjoy low latency of up to 40ms for responsive gaming audio, with dedicated Music and Gaming EQ modes to match your listening preferences, Bluetooth 6.0 and dual pairing let you connect with two compatible devices, while IPX4 water resistance helps protect against sweat and splashes

Half In-Ear Comfort Fit: Experience a lightweight half in-ear design that sits naturally in your ears. Built for long listening hours without pressure, perfect for everyday use, calls, and music on the go.
Powerful 13mm Sound: Enjoy rich audio with 13mm dynamic drivers that deliver deep bass and clear vocals. Designed to enhance your everyday listening across music, movies, and calls.
Quad Mic ENC for Clear Calls: Stay heard wherever you are with dual mic Environmental Noise Cancellation. Filters background noise so your voice comes through sharp and uninterrupted on every call.
Up to 40 Hours Playtime: Keep the music going with up to 40 hours of total playtime. The compact case ensures extended battery life for uninterrupted listening throughout your day.
Low Latency + BT v5.3 Connectivity: Switch to low latency mode for synced audio while gaming or streaming. BT 5.3 ensures faster pairing, stable connection, and seamless performance.
